content:
The **Veiled Sundew Grove** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia.

The Veiled Sundew Grove is an area full of mutated Sundew plants, situated northeast of Watoga. It has little loot aside from harvest nodes for Cranberries and Glowing Fungus. A Picklock 3 Safe can be found in the clearing in the center of the grove.

A Wendigo Colossus has a chance to appear when the area is nuked.

The Veiled Sundew Grove appears in *Fallout 76*.
